facts.fact: The 2024 finance law appropriates 1,387,136,000 F CFA in domestic payment credits to programme 095 'Développement d'infrastructures de communications électroniques' of the digital ministry (MTD-PCE), covering the government backbone and broadband access.
facts.system: MTD-PCE budget 2024, programme 095 Développement d'infrastructures de communications électroniques

facts.fact: The ministry's programme 095 line shows 272,081,258 F CFA actually spent for 2024 (19.6% of the 1,387,136,000 voted) in the state execution report to 31 December 2024; the document notes a 79.0% in-year cancellation of credits preceded this.
facts.system: MTD-PCE budget 2024, programme 095 Développement d'infrastructures de communications électroniques
